# google_integrations_integration_version_deployment

A deployment resource for managing the published/deployed state of an Application Integration version.


To get more information about IntegrationVersionDeployment, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/application-integration/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.integrations.versions)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/application-integration/docs/overview)

## Example Usage - Integrations Integration Version Deployment Basic


```hcl
resource "google_integrations_integration_version" "version" {
  location = "us-east4"
  integration = "%{integration_name}"
  description = "Integration version created via terraform"

  trigger_configs {
    label = "test_trigger"
    trigger_type = "API"
    trigger_number = "1"
    trigger_id = "api_trigger/test_trigger"
    properties = {
      "Trigger name" = "test_trigger"
    }
    start_tasks {
      task_id = "1"
    }
  }

  task_configs {
    task = "GenericRestV2Task"
    task_id = "1"
    external_task_type = "NORMAL_TASK"
    task_execution_strategy = "WHEN_ALL_SUCCEED"
    parameters {
      key = "url"
      masked = false
      value {
        boolean_value = false
        double_value = 0
        string_value = "https://example.com"
      }
    }
    parameters {
      key = "httpMethod"
      masked = false
      value {
        boolean_value = false
        double_value = 0
        string_value = "GET"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_integrations_integration_version_deployment" "deployment_basic" {
  location = "us-east4"
  integration = "%{integration_name}"
  version = google_integrations_integration_version.version.version
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  Location in which the integration version is deployed.

* `integration` -
  (Required)
  The name of the integration.

* `version` -
  (Required)
  The version ID of the integration to deploy/publish.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/integrations/{{integration}}/versions/{{version}}`

* `name` -
  The full resource name of the integration version.

* `state` -
  The state of the integration version (e.g. ACTIVE).

* `status` -
  The status of the integration version.

* `create_time` -
  The time the integration version was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time the integration version was last updated.

* `last_modifier_email` -
  The last modifier's email address.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


IntegrationVersionDeployment can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/integrations/{{integration}}/versions/{{version}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{integration}}/{{version}}`
* `{{location}}/{{integration}}/{{version}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import IntegrationVersionDeployment using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    integration = "<-required value->"
    version = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_integrations_integration_version_deployment.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import IntegrationVersionDeployment using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/integrations/{{integration}}/versions/{{version}}"
  to = google_integrations_integration_version_deployment.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), IntegrationVersionDeployment can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_integrations_integration_version_deployment.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/integrations/{{integration}}/versions/{{version}}
$ terraform import google_integrations_integration_version_deployment.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{integration}}/{{version}}
$ terraform import google_integrations_integration_version_deployment.default {{location}}/{{integration}}/{{version}}
```
